ruleDefinitions.name: CMSTP UAC Bypass via COM Object Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects UAC Bypass Attempt Using Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer Autoelevate-capable COM Objects (e.g. UACMe ID of 41, 43, 58 or 65)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\DllHost\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Processid\\:\\{3E5FC7F9\\-9A51\\-4367\\-9063\\-A120244FBEC7\\}.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Processid\\:\\{3E000D72\\-A845\\-4CD9\\-BD83\\-80C07C3B881F\\}.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Processid\\:\\{BD54C901\\-076B\\-434E\\-B6C7\\-17C531F4AB41\\}.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Processid\\:\\{D2E7041B\\-2927\\-42FB\\-8E9F\\-7CE93B6DC937\\}.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Processid\\:\\{E9495B87\\-D950\\-4AB5\\-87A5\\-FF6D70BF3E90\\}.*")) AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
